meta.title: WindSlayer EN 2008 -> EN 2009 (Outspark v1.04 build 14) client memory/patch map
meta.image_base: 0x400000 both (no ASLR); file_off = VA - 0x400000 for .text/.rdata in both builds

game_state.meaning: static CD3DApplication/game object (vtable at +0; everything else hangs off it)
game_state.evidence: 2009 FUN_00487d00 (WinMain body, 2008 FUN_00475840): MOV EDI,0x54ebd0 at 0x487D74 before FUN_0042b2b0 (subsystem allocation, 2008 FUN_00429b50); MOV ECX,0x54ebd0 at 0x487E0B -> FUN_0040c140 ('Failed to Create d3dApp.'), 0x487E47 -> FUN_0043f140 ('Failed to InitializeGame.'), 0x487E7F -> FUN_0040e370 (main loop). 2008: MOV ECX,0x70ea00 at 0x4758E1/0x475943, PUSH 0x70ea00 at 0x475912. Frame fn 0x40E440 uses it as this (CS at this+0x368).
game_state.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair

scene_ptr.meaning: pointer to the scene/session object (local uid, entity list, scene mode, clocks)
scene_ptr.evidence: 2009 0x487D96 MOV ECX,[0x54f0c0]; CMP [ECX+0xf18],EBX (2008 0x475875 MOV ECX,[0x70eecc]; CMP [ECX+0xf00],0). Per-tick FUN_0042c920 reads [this+0x4f0] for every scene access (2008 FUN_0042b260 [this+0x4cc]); 0x02 handler 0x4525F1 MOV EDX,[ESI+0x4f0]; MOV EAX,[EDX+0x224] (2008 0x44DFDA [ESI+0x4cc]/[EDX+0x220]).
scene_ptr.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair

anim_container_ptr.meaning: anim/template record container (list: head +0x10, count +0x18, cursor +0x1C; node.next=[node], payload=[node+8]); looked up by 1-based entity+anim_index
anim_container_ptr.evidence: 0x1A handler 2009 0x456B73 MOV EDX,[ECX+0x504]; CALL 0x409EF0 (2008 0x451E41 MOV EDX,[EDX+0x4e0]; CALL 0x409770 RosterLookupByIndex). Render 2009 0x433512/0x4335C9 MOV EDX,[EBX+0x504]; CALL 0x409F30 (2008 0x431B78/0x431C2F [EDI+0x4e0]; CALL 0x4097B0). Allocation FUN_0042b2b0 stores FUN_00408ba0 (0x130-byte object) at +0x504 and copies it to scene+0xFA8 (2008 FUN_00429b50: FUN_00408450, 0x128 bytes, +0x4E0, scene+0xF7C).
anim_container_ptr.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair; both lookup functions (0x409EF0, 0x409F30) are byte-identical to 2008 0x409770/0x4097B0, so the list layout is unchanged
anim_container_ptr.diff_vs_2008: game_state offset +0x4E0 -> +0x504; container object 0x128 -> 0x130 bytes; RECORD layout changed: name +0 same, anim block +0x250 -> +0x254 (10 -> 13 dwords), +0x63C->+0x64C, level +0x640->+0x650, class +0x644->+0x654, max HP +0x648->+0x658, +0x650..+0x66C -> +0x660..+0x67C, +0x67C/+0x680 -> +0x68C/+0x690 (enum_container.py must read class at +0x654, sub at +0x658)

map_object_ptr.meaning: map/room object (room mode flag, room number); also copied to scene+0xF88/+0xFB4
map_object_ptr.evidence: FUN_0042b2b0 allocates 0x470 bytes (FUN_004052f0) into +0x4FC and copies it to scene+0xFB4 (2008 FUN_00429b50: 0x3E0 bytes, FUN_00405180, +0x4D8, scene+0xF88). Per-tick 2009 0x42C920 tests [[this+0x4fc]+0x7c]==0 (2008 [[this+0x4d8]+0x70]==0). UDP handler 2009 compares [[gs+0x4fc]+0x1c4] with the snapshot room number (2008 +0x1b8).
map_object_ptr.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair
map_object_ptr.diff_vs_2008: game_state +0x4D8 -> +0x4FC; object 0x3E0 -> 0x470 bytes; room-mode field +0x70 -> +0x7C; room number +0x1B8 -> +0x1C4; new +0x2E0 flag used by per-tick in room mode (FUN_0042a300)

g_sock_game.meaning: CSNSocket* for the game TCP connection (all S2C GetDataFromPacket and C2S Add/Send)
g_sock_game.evidence: CreateSockets 2009 FUN_00440640: first CSNSocket::Create(0,1) stored to 0x54E828 (2008 CreateSockets 0x440150 -> g_sock_game 0x70E6F4); copied to scene+0xFC0 (2008 scene+0xF94). Every OnReceive read uses MOV ECX,[0x54e828] (e.g. 0x452225, 0x456B1F..0x4570AC).
g_sock_game.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair

g_sock_version.meaning: CSNSocket* for the version-server TCP connection
g_sock_version.evidence: ConnectToVersionServer 2009 FUN_00440880 at 0x4409BD MOV ECX,[0x54e82c]; PUSH 0x1b63; PUSH 0x52dd54; CALL Connect (2008 0x44048D MOV ECX,[0x70e6f8]; PUSH 0x1b63; PUSH 0x6f79f8). FUN_00440640 second Create(0,1) stores to 0x54E82C.
g_sock_version.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair

g_sock_udp.meaning: UDP CSNSocket* bound to 42907 (0xA79B): loopback input, LAN probe, room snapshots; copied to scene+0xFBC
g_sock_udp.evidence: FUN_00440640: Create(0xA79B, 2) at 0x4407F9.. stored to 0x54E830 and scene+0xFBC (2008 Create(0xa79b,2) at 0x4402D0 -> 0x70E6FC, scene+0xF90). LAN probe in S2C 0x02 uses [0x54e830] at 0x4525D3..0x452627 (2008 [0x70e6fc] 0x44DFBC..0x44E010).
g_sock_udp.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair

g_sock_extra_tcp.meaning: NEW in 2009: a third TCP CSNSocket (Create(0,1)) created between the version and UDP sockets
g_sock_extra_tcp.evidence: FUN_00440640 stores it at 0x440785 (MOV [0x54e834],ECX). No other code reference to 0x54E834 exists in the 2009 asm corpus.

socket_listeners.meaning: CSNSockMyListener objects (vftable + game_state) passed to CSNSocket ctor
socket_listeners.evidence: FUN_00440640 decomp: DAT_0054e838 = new listener before the TCP sockets, DAT_0054e83c before the UDP socket (2008 DAT_0070e700 / DAT_0070e704).
socket_listeners.verification: decomp + asm of the 2009 site read and compared with the 2008 site (same instruction pattern); cross-checked by token alignment of the matched function pair

OnReceive 0x45199A LEA EAX,[ESI+0x368] + EnterCS 0x4519A5 (2008 0x44D60A/0x44D615). UDP handler 0x45E26A/0x45E275 (2008 0x458688). WndProc WM_TIMER 0x43EB79 LEA EAX,[EBX+0x368] + EnterCS 0x43EB80.

frame_time_ms.meaning: timeGetTime() of the current frame; per-tick copies it to scene logic-time fields
frame_time_ms.evidence: Frame 2009 0x40E670 MOV [ESI+0x364],EAX after timeGetTime (2008 in_EAX[0xd9]); per-tick 2009 copies [this+0x364] into scene+0xF38 at the end (2008 scene+0xF20).

tick_step_ms.meaning: NEW: logic-tick step in ms passed to the wander/AI tick and used by the movement/hit code; per-tick toggles it between 30 and 0 while scene+0xF3C (new time-scale mode) is set
tick_step_ms.evidence: per-tick 0x42C97E/0x42C9A6 (DAT_0054a284 = (DAT!=30)?30:0 when scene+0xF3C!=0); passed as arg 2 of FUN_004185b0 (wander AI) which adds it to scene+0xF34 at 0x4185C7 (2008 FUN_00417e10 0x417E23 ADD [scene+0xf1c],0x1e constant). Read by FUN_004129f0/0x414210/0x415F80/0x416AB0.
tick_step_ms.verification: decomp + asm of FUN_0042c920 and FUN_004185b0; initial value read from the .data image

notes: How this was built: function pairs were matched by call-graph position, unique string xrefs ('Timer Error.', 'No response from the server.', version-server IP, 'Failed to Create d3dApp.'), byte identity (0x409EF0, 0x409F30, 0x40D990) and a normalized-token alignment of the two Ghidra decomps (constants paired only inside equal token runs; ratios 0.60-0.99 are listed per function). Every offset listed as high confidence was then confirmed by reading the concrete 2008 and 2009 instructions given in 'evidence'. Key layout facts: game_state moved 0x70EA00 -> 0x54EBD0 but most of its low fields (+0x368 CS, +0x364 frame time, +0x34C/+0x350 screen, +0xA8 present params) keep their offsets; the subsystem pointer block moved +0x4C4..+0x4E0 -> +0x4E8..+0x504 (+0x24) and the busy flag +0x408 -> +0x418. Scene shifts are piecewise (+4 at 0x220/0x244, +8 at 0x25C, +0x18 for 0x96D..0xF20, +0x1C for 0xF24..0xF68 because a new dword sits at 2009 +0xF3C, +0x2C for 0xF78..0xF98). Entity (alloc 0x15F0 -> 0x16B8) shifts are also piecewise: +4 (0x84..0xB4), +0x8C (0x8B3..0x8E3), +0x8D (0x8E4), +0x90 (0x904..0xDBC), +0x9C (0xDE8..0xE84), +0xA0 (0x107C..0x14F0), +0xB8 (0x1598..0x15B4). Do not apply a single delta. Tool retargeting summary: SCENE_PTR 0x54F0C0, ANIM_PTR 0x54F0D4, GAME_STATE 0x54EBD0; scene local uid +0x224, mode +0xF18, local player +0x988; entity uid +0x88, type +0x9C, level +0x9D, HP +0xA0, MP +0xA4, max HP +0x11AC, max MP +0x11B0, anim index +0xEFC, pos f64 +0x1298/+0x1328, swing flag +0x944, render state +0x166C (attack == 4), drawn pos +0x165C/+0x1660; container records: class +0x654, sub +0x658. Behaviour changes that matter for tooling: (1) 2009 no longer sends the field-map type-4 UDP snapshot to itself; field entities' drawn state is applied on the main thread each tick by the new FUN_004510a0 -> FUN_004511b0, so the 2008 stutter mechanism (starved UDP loopback) is largely gone, although TCP handling and the looped-back type-3 input still contend for game_state+0x368. (2) The logic tick step is now a global (0x54A284, 30 ms) that can alternate 30/0 in a new time-scale mode flagged by scene+0xF3C, which also suppresses 'Timer Error'. (3) In the 0x1A and 0x07 handlers the two f64 positions are read before RegisterLocalPlayer (after it in 2008). (4) A third TCP CSNSocket (0x54E834) is created but never referenced. Not resolved / caveats: semantics of the new scene+0xF3C mode and of map+0x2E0 (room-mode path FUN_0042a300) were not traced; the game_state vtable base is inferred from the frame function's +0x18 call (medium); secondary scene offsets are medium confidence (from alignment plus one or two spot checks); nothing here was live-tested against the 2009 client except the facts given in the task (X-Trap stubs, version string/port). The 2008 patched exes differ from WindSlayer.exe exactly by: version IP, update URL, WM_TIMER table entry, LAN-probe NOP, room SendTo NOP (pre_smooth); plus the smooth cave (WindSlayer_patched.exe), the 4 port immediates (_p2), the fullscreen patch (.bak_fullscreen) and the 1280x960 immediates (_hires).
